title: The Beasts of Tarzan
summary: In this adventure novel, Lord Greystoke (Tarzan) and his wife Jane must rescue their kidnapped son from the clutches of the villainous Nikolas Rokoff. After being marooned in an unknown jungle following a treacherous scheme by Rokoff, Tarzan endures numerous perils, battles wild beasts, and forges unlikely alliances with apes and panthers to track down his family. The story follows their harrowing journey through the African wilderness, filled with betrayal, survival, and relentless pursuit, culminating in a dramatic rescue that restores Tarzan’s family and brings justice upon Rokoff.
